scientific_integrity: The finite grid statements have an analytic proof. Finite and numerical reproducibility checks are separate from that proof. Previously known randomized block algorithms and general expected-contraction identities are credited. Novelty comparison has literature-access and indexing limitations.
scientific_limitations: One exact coordinate-block update on the specified real SPD periodic screened-Poisson system; fixed block length and static probabilities. The theorem does not address adaptive rules, floating-point error, runtime, or exact multiple-step worst-case behavior.
title: Sharp optimal cyclic-block Gauss–Seidel contraction and a screened-Poisson crossover
